points.text: propan-1-ol: $\text{O}-\text{H}$ bond strengthened by positive inductive effect of alkyl group OR propoxide ion is destabilised by positive inductive effect of alkyl group
phenol: $\text{O}-\text{H}$ bond weakened by negative inductive effect of ring OR phenoxide ion is stabilised by delocalisation of oxygen lone pair into ring
propanoic acid: $\text{O}-\text{H}$ bond weakened by negative inductive effect of $\text{C=O}$ OR propanoate ion is stabilised by delocalisation of minus charge by $\text{C=O}$
points.guidance: 1 mark for a correct explanation, max 2 marks

points.text: methanoic acid gives a silver mirror/solid with Tollen's reagent OR red / orange ppt / solid with Fehling's reagent
add product of first step to phenol in NaOH
propan-1-ol would have peak at 0.5–6.0 because of $\text{OH}$ group
propanal would have peak at 9.3–10.5 because of $\text{CHO}$ / aldehyde
